daily.title: Nick Reiner will not face death penalty over parents' killings, prosecutors say
daily.summary: Nick Reiner is accused of murdering his father, famous Hollywood director and actor Rob Reiner, and his mother Michele.

daily.title: China tightens travel restrictions on its own citizens amid AI race with US
daily.summary: China has imposed travel restrictions on its citizens, including exit bans on those deemed to endanger the country's "industrial or technological security".

daily.title: The US has admitted deploying weapons in space and China is sounding the alarm
daily.summary: The revelation by Washington confirmed an open secret but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with Beijing and the risk of a weapons race in space.

daily.title: 'Complete failure': UK baby killer inquiry findings handed down
daily.summary: British nurse Lucy Letby was able to murder seven babies because of a "complete failure" to protect babies at the hospital at which she worked, and some of the deaths could have been avoided, the chair of an inquiry has said.

daily.title: Russia and Ukraine trade energy strikes, as NATO downs drone in Lithuania
daily.summary: The US president declared both sides would refrain from striking energy-related targets as petrol and diesel prices rise.

daily.title: 'Disgusting': Leaders condemn alleged Islamophobic attack on bus
daily.summary: The Special Envoy to Combat Islamophobia says the "victim pool" is getting younger, after a Muslim girl was allegedly called an "immigrant mutt" and a "terrorist" on a Sydney bus last week. A man was charged on Tuesday.

daily.title: Impact of colonisation on First Nations people far greater than previous estimates, research finds
daily.summary: Australia's Indigenous population was up to seven times larger before colonisation than previously estimated, but was devastated following the arrival of Europeans, new research reveals.

daily.title: Western Renewables Link passes planning hurdle as cost review ordered
daily.summary: The Victorian premier orders a cost assessment of the controversial Western Renewables Link hours after the planning minister approves its environment effects statement.

daily.title: Aussie fashion brand Cue Clothing falls into receivership
daily.summary: Sydney-based fashion business Cue Clothing Co, which operates Cue and its sister brand Veronika Maine, has entered receivership.

daily.title: ODI live scores: Australia faces Zimbabwe in first of African series
daily.summary: The Australian men's team's journey to the highly anticipated Test series against South Africa starts in Harare with the first of three ODIs against Zimbabwe. Check out the live scores and stats in our ScoreCentre.

daily.title: Mother's videos of dying toddler may be used to train junior doctors
daily.summary: The mother of two-year-old Pippa White, who died in a NSW Hospital after diagnosis and treatment delays has welcomed the prospect of videos of her symptoms being used to train doctors.

daily.title: Detective had three theories about Queensland mum's 1998 disappearance
daily.summary: A former Queensland police officer who led an investigation into missing mother Joanne Butterfield has told a coronial inquest he cannot recall why there was no DNA analysis of her personal belongings.

daily.title: SA school charged after student hurt in hammer-throw incident
daily.summary: SafeWork SA has lodged criminal proceedings against Christian Brothers College over a 2024 athletics incident in which a student was struck with a hammer-throw ball.

daily.title: Thirty years after doctors removed her gonads, this woman finally has answers
daily.summary: When Linda Brodie gave birth to her baby, it was a "joyous moment", but a decision made soon after to undertake surgery changed her daughter's life.

daily.title: Minister 'very confident' private maternity care will return to Darwin
daily.summary: Private maternity services could soon make a long-awaited return to the Northern Territory — but a shortage of health staff in Darwin has cast doubt on how long it might take.

daily.title: Analysts warn of 'uncontrolled demand destruction' as oil forecast to hit record high
daily.summary: With no sign of de-escalation, there is a higher risk the expanding Iran war will push oil prices even higher than the level it reached during the global financial crisis in 2008.

daily.title: Three-year-old girl dies after being hit by car in Western Sydney
daily.summary: Police were told the girl was hit by a car while it was entering a driveway in Western Sydney.

daily.title: Cowan warns BBL privatisation could 'spiral out of control'
daily.summary: Former Australian Test opener Ed Cowan believes the Big Bash League is already attracting the game's biggest star without private investment.

daily.title: 'AI hallucinations' scuttle parole board's gag order on convicted murderer
daily.summary: Tasmania's parole board has failed in a bid to keep in place a ban on a convicted murderer speaking to the media because its argument in the Supreme Court cited case law that was "hallucinated" by AI.

daily.title: Teens in court over Perth Zoo attack on crocodile
daily.summary: Police say the teens, aged 16 and 17, allegedly cut the locks of a crocodile enclosure before one of them struck the reptile on Sunday night.

daily.title: 'Disappointing outcome': Big Splash likely won't reopen for summer
daily.summary: The future of Canberra's water park Big Splash remains uncertain after the ACT government today said it did not believe it would reopen for the summer, as had been promised by the site's lessee.

daily.title: Kylie Minogue's gold hotpants take pride of place in anniversary exhibition
daily.summary: Peter Allen's world famous maracas and a custom-made vest for pioneering Indigenous singer Archie Roach are also among items on display for the 50th anniversary of the Australian Performing Arts Collection.

daily.title: Man sentenced for 'callous' New Year one-punch attack at shopping centre
daily.summary: Jairlan Victor Bruce Simpson punched another man before searching his pockets as he lay unconscious in an "appalling" New Year's Day attack.

daily.title: Biosecurity concerns trigger Vietnam fruit import pause
daily.summary: The Australian government suspends pomelo imports just months after market access was first granted.

daily.title: Former Olympic coach left with ongoing damage after 36-hour hospital ordeal
daily.summary: Former Olympic coach Patrick Gemzik said he's been left with permanent eye and brain damage after waiting more than 36 hours to undergo an emergency surgery.

developing.title: Live: ASX falls sharply, oil hits two-month high amid US-Iran strikes
developing.summary: The Australian share market is recording heavy losses after the US launched fresh strikes against Iran, driving oil prices up and contributing to a global bond sell-off. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Four more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet flood disaster
developing.summary: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe after the Nepal-Tibet flood, with the number of unaccounted-for Australians revised down to 38. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Iran says US will 'regret' new wave of attacks
developing.summary: The new round of strikes comes after Iran attempted to attack American troops and commercial ships in the region, according to US central command. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hadley sent text message saying Jones 'needs to be destroyed', court told
developing.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.

developing.title: Live: Hadley back in the witness box for a third day, as Jones trial resumes
developing.summary: Ray Hadley returns for a third day to Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial, which has been examining the pair's "tumultuous" relationship.

developing.title: Live: ASX to open higher after sea of green on Wall Street
developing.summary: The ASX is set to open higher after gains on Wall Street. The price of oil is above $US95/barrel as the bond market steadies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Opposition leader says teachers running 'political agendas' in schools
developing.summary: Angus Taylor would not say whether he agreed with comments from Nationals leader Matt Canavan that there needed to be more male teachers in classrooms. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hawks on verge of stunning upset as Dockers need a miracle
developing.summary: Fremantle's finals campaign starts with a stern test in the west, taking on Hawthorn in the first qualifying final at Perth Stadium. Follow live.
